## Sources represented

- The official documentation website at [`https://dict.thinktrader.net/`](https://dict.thinktrader.net/), including the XTQuant Native API, data dictionary, and QMT simulation-account support material.
- The official `xtquant 250807.1.2` PyPI distribution, used only to extract its two bundled Markdown manuals and to derive static API indexes. The wheel and its binaries/source are not committed here.
- The official Xuntou [`XtQuant`](https://github.com/Xuntou/XtQuant) GitHub repository, pinned to commit `5d5cfbd26972e5efe7f53759c3efcf9743730e42` for the older `version_241014` documentation snapshot.

## License evidence and uncertainty

- The documentation website states copyright but does not publish a documentation redistribution license on the archived pages.
- The official GitHub repository contained no `LICENSE` file at the pinned commit.
- The PyPI wheel metadata contains the classifier `License :: OSI Approved :: MIT License`, but the wheel contains no `LICENSE` file and no explicit metadata `License` field. This archive does not assume that the classifier licenses the website or bundled manuals for unrestricted redistribution.

Accordingly, this corpus should be treated as a provenance-preserving reference snapshot for evaluation and interoperability work. Retain this notice, the per-page provenance banners, `manifest.json`, and `checksums.sha256`. Before publishing or redistributing the third-party texts beyond the context for which they were obtained, review the current upstream terms and obtain permission where required.

Nothing in this notice is legal advice or a representation that any particular use is authorized.
